candidate_04 is highest-activity but costs 22.3266 USD/t in the broader target_core optimization; its exact refined parity requirement versus candidate_13 is 201.22x intrinsic activity, far above the 2.52x maximum gain across process states on the frozen descriptor manifold.
candidate_05 is also higher-activity than candidate_13 but costs 25.8318 USD/t and has higher metal price than candidate_04, so it is not industrially competitive in the optimized set.
All other candidates are lower reference activity and higher metal price than candidate_13 and are therefore screened by the declared dominance rule.

model_validity_notes.edge_resolution: candidate_13 was re-optimized in a positive-Tsep extension and improved; the final Tsep=30 C is the global admissible upper bound. A further CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY on the final extension was unaffordable; bed volume 17.06 m3 is well below the 90 m3 cap.

llm_final_answer.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible lowest-cost incumbent exists; S2 no unresolved candidates after optimizing higher-activity candidates 04/05 and screening all lower-activity/higher-price candidates by the declared rule; S3 highest-activity candidate parity and reachability have been executed and classified unreachable. Remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value; MC and final model-validity checks are unaffordable with remaining budget.

unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty: Descriptor uncertainty was read but MC uncertainty propagation was unaffordable, so probability of lowest cost under uncertainty is not quantified.
unresolved_decision_risk.window_edge: Final candidate_13 optimum is at the global Tsep maximum (30 C); no higher Tsep is admissible, but an exact final window-edge check was unaffordable. candidate_04/candidate_05 T=450 C edge risk exists, but their costs are substantially higher and parity requirement is unreachable by activity alone.
unresolved_decision_risk.screening_rule: Non-optimized candidates rely on declared screening rule rather than exact state-level dominance checks; exact dominance checks were unaffordable.
unresolved_decision_risk.overall: Low-to-moderate residual risk; unlikely to overturn the industrial choice under the canonical model because candidate_13 has a large cost advantage and candidate_04 cannot reach parity via intrinsic activity on the frozen manifold.
